review_candidates.title: Regional SDR Director
review_candidates.description_excerpt: In this role your primary objective is to direct regional SDR & BDR managers and teams across AMER, EMEA, and APAC, and maintain a multi-million dollar pipeline.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We value Excellent academic results at school and university Bachelor’s or equivalent degree in Business or STEM Knowledge and passion for business development, sales and technology Track record of bringing exceptional outbound sales development results Commitment to continuous learning and improvement - curious, flexible, scientific Creative problem solving and cross team collaboration Leadership experience of one form or another Able to use data to drive team activities and continuous improvement Multi-regional strategic vision tailored to AMER, EMEA, and APAC market dynamics Track record of recruiting, mentoring, and developing SDR Team Managers (leading leaders) Cross-functional alignment with Regional Sales VPs, Marketing, and Field Engineering Expertise in leveraging modern sales tech stacks and CRM analytics for predictable pipeline forecasting Scalable talent pipeline management
